symbols.name: DocumentStoreModelBuilderExtensions
symbols.summary: Provides model configuration for the BridgingIT.DevKit.Infrastructure.EntityFramework.StorageDocument entity that cannot be expressed with annotations.
symbols.remarks: Calling BridgingIT.DevKit.Infrastructure.EntityFramework.DocumentStoreModelBuilderExtensions.ApplyDocumentStoreConfiguration(Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.ModelBuilder) is optional. Without it the document store stays correct, only the expiration index covers every row instead of just the rows that expire, which makes it larger.

symbols.name: ApplyDocumentStoreConfiguration(ModelBuilder)
symbols.summary: Turns the (TypeHash, ExpiresAtUnixMilliseconds) index of BridgingIT.DevKit.Infrastructure.EntityFramework.StorageDocument into a filtered index that only contains rows with an expiration. Most documents never expire, so the index shrinks accordingly and the retention sweep scans only expiring rows.
